cases.input: Dispute D has first-instance proceeding P1 and appeal P2 challenging J1.
cases.expect: D links both proceedings while P1, P2 and J1 retain separate identities.

cases.input: Evidence EV7 is admitted under protective order O3 and the case later closes.
cases.expect: The restriction survives closure and appeal until an authorized successor order changes it.

cases.input: Appeal P2 sets judgment J1 aside.
cases.expect: J1 and its findings remain resolvable while remedy effect changes append-only.

cases.input: A pleaded amount is booked as confirmed debt.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected without an enforceable decision, settlement or contract basis.

cases.input: An appellate reversal deletes the first-instance judgment.
cases.expect: Deletion is rejected.

cases.input: A docket-use ruling replaces evidence custody and integrity history.
cases.expect: The substitution is rejected.

cases.input: A local case number alone is used as global proceeding identity.
cases.expect: Rejected: a case number is a non-identifying source-qualified alias even when forum-qualified; only an opaque assigned proceeding identifier is identity.

cases.input: Profile declares bases WM-POL-009, WM-KNW-007, WM-KNW-008, WM-KNW-010, WM-ECO-006, WM-ECO-018 and lists WM-POL-019/020/021 under blockedBases with profileBinding none.
cases.expect: Accepted; no constraint is evaluated against a blocked base and no reserved specification is promoted.

cases.input: Profile binds WM-POL-019 as an active base and relies on it as a required CHILD component.
cases.expect: Rejected: the base has no complete specification, so the composition is unsatisfiable.

cases.input: WM-POL-022 is bound as the Appeal / Review base.
cases.expect: Rejected: WM-POL-022 is reserved as Sanction / Sentence and no appeal identifier is reserved.

cases.input: WM-POL-022 appears only in relationContradictions with registryName Sanction / Sentence and resolution registry adjudication.
cases.expect: Accepted; contradiction recorded without base binding or identifier use.

cases.input: WM-POL-023 is added to bases or to the reservations to satisfy the enforcement reference.
cases.expect: Rejected: the target is absent from the reservations and may only be recorded as dangling.

cases.input: WM-POL-023 is recorded in danglingReferences as referencedBy WM-POL-021 with action record-only.
cases.expect: Accepted; the dangling enforcement reference is visible and unresolved.

cases.input: A sealing order records actKind, authorityRef, competenceBasis, initiatedBy, authorizedBy, effectiveFrom and recordedAt with initiatedBy different from authorizedBy.
cases.expect: Accepted as an append-only authority act.

cases.input: Admissibility is stored as a boolean flag with no authorityRef or competence basis.
cases.expect: Rejected: admissibility is an authority act, not a flag.

cases.input: The same actor is recorded as initiatedBy and authorizedBy for a finality assertion.
cases.expect: Rejected: initiation and authorization must be separated.

cases.input: recordClasses marks DisputeMatter enterprise-mastered, proceeding-derived attributes source-qualified-mirror, party identity and forum organization externally-mastered.
cases.expect: Accepted; mastership layers are explicit.

cases.input: The dispute record asserts mastership over the forum docket.
cases.expect: Rejected: the forum masters the docket and the enterprise record is a source-qualified mirror.

cases.input: The same dispute and proceeding carry a primary membership and a later consolidation membership with different relationKind and validFrom.
cases.expect: Accepted; the four-part membership identity admits both rows.

cases.input: One proceeding holds two open memberships with relationKind primary to two different disputes.
cases.expect: Rejected: a proceeding has exactly one open primary Dispute / Matter.

cases.input: A severance appends a DisputeRelation of kind severed-from with authorityRef while both dispute identities are retained.
cases.expect: Accepted; append-only typed relation, no identity merge.

cases.input: successorRef on the dispute root is used to merge two dispute identities into one.
cases.expect: Rejected: dispute identities never merge and the untyped successor field is removed.

cases.input: An ECLI, or a forum plus case number plus year, is used as the dispute or proceeding identifier.
cases.expect: Rejected: those keys never identify a dispute or proceeding, alone or combined.

cases.input: Case number, title and ECLI are stored as aliasKeys with aliasScheme, sourceRef and sourceAsOf and identityUse forbidden.
cases.expect: Accepted; alias keys are non-identifying and claim no uniqueness.

cases.input: A retired disputeMatterId is reassigned to a new matter.
cases.expect: Rejected: dispute identifiers are never recycled and retired identifiers are retained.

cases.input: ProceedingMembership stores challengedDecisionRef, grounds and effect for an appeal.
cases.expect: Rejected: that is review-link mastership for an identifier-unassigned gap over an incomplete judgment master.

cases.input: deferredStructures records ReviewLink, EnforcementRecognitionCase and RemedyObligation with fieldsActive false and no identifier.
cases.expect: Accepted; the gaps remain unassigned and unimplemented.

cases.input: Case Outcome is given its own identity, lifecycle and finality mastership.
cases.expect: Rejected: a projection is never promoted to a root or a second master of finality.

cases.input: Case Outcome is rendered with asOf and derivedFrom, nonAuthoritative true, no identity and no lifecycle.
cases.expect: Accepted as an as-of projection over judgment, finality and remedy references.

cases.input: A dispute moves resolved to reopened with authorityRef, initiatedBy, authorizedBy and effectiveFrom, and prior states are retained.
cases.expect: Accepted as a declared, append-only transition.

cases.input: A dispute transitions from retained to active, or from identified directly to closed with no authority act.
cases.expect: Rejected: retained is a retention flag, not a state, and undeclared transitions are refused.

cases.input: A dispute is closed while a primary ProceedingMembership is still open and no openProceedingAcknowledgement is recorded.
cases.expect: Rejected: closure preconditions are unmet.

cases.input: Closure records an authority act, sets membership validTo, and preserves memberships, relations, filings, evidence rulings, judgments and restrictions.
cases.expect: Accepted as non-destructive closure with no cascade.

cases.input: The dispute declares a CONTAINS relation to WM-POL-009 proceedings.
cases.expect: Rejected: the dispute references proceedings and never contains them or their docket; CONTAINS contracts are unapproved.

cases.input: Every boundary reference carries relationKind REFERENCES, direction outbound, cardinality 0..n, required false, lifecycleContract unapproved-candidate and mastershipTransferred false.
cases.expect: Accepted; reference contracts are explicit and uninstallable until approved.

cases.input: WM-KNW-010 rationale is treated as conferring legal force, or its CHILD edge is used to inherit WM-KNW-007 parentage.
cases.expect: Rejected: the edge triple is unresolved and rationale confers no legal force or parentage.

cases.input: The WM-KNW-010 reference records the CHILD/EXTEND/ALIGN contradiction and absent ledger parent as a caveat with rationale-only use.
cases.expect: Accepted; the contradiction is visible and bounded.

cases.input: declaredGaps records evidence identity, custody and integrity as declared by WM-KNW-008 with intended owner WM-POL-020 reserved-incomplete and currentOwner none.
cases.expect: Accepted; the custody gap is explicit and unowned rather than silently absorbed by the case.

cases.input: Service time is defaulted from membership validFrom, or one timestamp stands for filing, service, effect and knowledge.
cases.expect: Rejected: times are distinct and no time is derived from another.

cases.input: Filing, receipt, service, legal effect, finality, publication, enforcement, observation, ingestion and knowledge times are stored separately in RFC 3339 with seconds and explicit offsets.
cases.expect: Accepted; all times remain distinct and comparable.

cases.input: A dispute or membership assertion is stored with no assertedBy and no assertionCapacity.
cases.expect: Rejected: every assertion names author and procedural capacity.

cases.input: reviewProvenance records the Grok study as visible-response-only with promptState recorded-as-unsent, transportVerification none, hidden reasoning and sources control excluded.
cases.expect: Accepted; evidentiary weight is limited to the visible text.

cases.input: The holds still state that independent Grok review is pending after the review has been supplied and reconciled.
cases.expect: Rejected: the hold is stale and must record the reconciled, provenance-qualified state.

cases.input: Access defaults to allow, or sealed and protective-order material is served through the public view.
cases.expect: Rejected: access defaults deny and sealed material is excluded from the public view.

cases.input: The statistical view returns a single dispute or carries linkage keys that permit re-identification.
cases.expect: Rejected: the statistical view forbids single-dispute disclosure and re-identification.

cases.input: A protective order restriction is inherited into the successor appellate proceeding by reference to the originating order rather than by copy.
cases.expect: Accepted; the restriction survives and remains bound to the act that created it.

cases.input: A set-aside withdraws access to the prior decision, its findings and its evidence rulings.
cases.expect: Rejected: access to the set-aside decision and its record is unchanged.

cases.input: A claimedAmount and currency are stored on the dispute root.
cases.expect: Rejected: amounts are proceeding-owned relief sought and are forbidden fields on the root.

cases.input: A WM-ECO-018 provision is derived from or subscribed to the claim or judgment amount.
cases.expect: Rejected: no financial-statement draft subscribes to claim amounts and no provision is auto-derived.

cases.input: A provision is remeasured by a separate accounting act with measurement basis, estimate binding, disclosure class, authorityRef and initiatedBy different from authorizedBy.
cases.expect: Accepted; recognition carries its own authority and never becomes confirmed debt.

cases.input: The profile asserts canonical completeness, installability or publication readiness.
cases.expect: Rejected: all bases are publishableCanonical false and three required child specifications are incomplete.

cases.input: Profile carries canonicalPublishable false, newRuntimeId false, newCatalogueId false and publicationHold held; the README states the same hold.
cases.expect: Accepted; publication is held consistently across artifacts.

cases.input: The profile claims appellate, recognition or enforcement coverage, or subtypes appeal into the first-instance profile.
cases.expect: Rejected: those records are identifier-unassigned gaps outside the profile scope.

cases.input: outOfProfileScope lists Appeal / Review, Enforcement / Recognition Case, Remedy Obligation, filing content, evidence custody, judgment content, remedy execution and finance identity, while an appellate docket may still be recorded as a separate proceeding instance.
cases.expect: Accepted; Claude and Grok are reconciled without extending coverage.

cases.input: Validation accepts a negative fixture with no expectedCode, no target and no closesDefect.
cases.expect: Rejected: the policy requires targets, violates mapping, defect closure and unique expected codes.

cases.input: Policy v2 carries contourId EM-LEG-05, minimumFixtures 76, minimumPositiveFixtures 29, minimumNegativeFixtures 47, minimumInvariants 18, minimumReferences 6 and the forbids-promotion, forbids-root, provenance, access, time and finance requirements.
cases.expect: Accepted; the remediated artifacts validate deterministically.

cases.input: Two fixtures share an id or an expectedCode, or a fixture omits its target.
cases.expect: Rejected: fixture ids and codes are unique and every fixture names its target.

cases.input: Fixture inventory declares existing 7, added 69, total 76, positive 29, negative 47 and records the brief discrepancy against the stated figure of 4.
cases.expect: Accepted; counted inventory equals declared inventory.

cases.input: An unrebutted party allegation is promoted to an adjudicated finding.
cases.expect: Rejected: allegation, admission, finding and legal conclusion never merge and absence of rebuttal upgrades nothing.

cases.input: A procedural claim, a WM-KNW-007 party allegation, an adjudicated finding and a legal conclusion with pinned norm and provision version coexist, each naming author and procedural capacity.
cases.expect: Accepted; four separable assertion classes with distinct owners.

cases.input: A finding is recorded without the burden and standard applied for its issue.
cases.expect: Rejected: burden and standard are recorded per issue.

cases.input: ProceedingEvent is used as the filing master in place of the missing WM-POL-019 specification.
cases.expect: Rejected: the docket event is case-owned chronology and is not a filing specification.

cases.input: A ProceedingEvent is appended with actor, authority, rule, effect interval and separate filing, receipt, acceptance and service times, and remains case-owned.
cases.expect: Accepted as an append-only dependent docket component, not a root.

cases.input: Admissibility or permitted use is stored as a property of the evidence item itself.
cases.expect: Rejected: admissibility and use are proceeding-scoped rulings distinct from evidence identity and custody.

cases.input: A procedural claim is re-parented from the receiving proceeding to the dispute root.
cases.expect: Rejected: claims, counterclaims and defenses are owned by the receiving proceeding.

cases.input: A counterclaim is stored as a negation flag on the opposing claim.
cases.expect: Rejected: counterclaim and defense are distinct responsive assertions with their own proponent and capacity.

cases.input: The appellate proceeding takes over, renumbers or replaces the first-instance proceeding identity.
cases.expect: Rejected: an appeal is a successor proceeding with its own identity and never replaces the first instance.

cases.input: Dispute closure cascades deletion or tombstoning to filings, evidence rulings, judgments or successor memberships.
cases.expect: Rejected: closure is non-destructive with no cascade.

cases.input: Party master data is copied into the dispute root instead of referenced through partyCapacityRefs.
cases.expect: Rejected: party identity is externally mastered and held by reference only.

cases.input: A forum organization is created as a dispute-owned child record.
cases.expect: Rejected: forum organizations remain external and qualify the proceeding, not the matter.

cases.input: A judgment reference is recorded without deciding forum authority, competence basis and decision date.
cases.expect: Rejected: every decision names forum authority, competence and date.

cases.input: Finality is asserted at issuance, or correction, recognition and enforcement are collapsed into the issuance event.
cases.expect: Rejected: issuance, correction, finality, recognition and enforcement remain distinct.

cases.input: Enforcement or recognition is recorded as a docket event inside the first-instance proceeding.
cases.expect: Rejected: recognition and enforcement use distinct proceedings and jurisdictions and remain unassigned gaps.

cases.input: Rendering a Case Outcome instantiates a Remedy Obligation record.
cases.expect: Rejected: a remedy obligation is not implied by the outcome projection and remains an unassigned gap.

cases.input: modelId or registryId is populated, or allocationState is changed away from unassigned.
cases.expect: Rejected: this contour allocates no catalogue or runtime identifier.

cases.input: A single-forum matter ends in one final judgment with exactly one proceeding membership and no related proceeding.
cases.expect: Accepted; the dispute identity remains independent and no later related filing forces renumbering of the original proceeding.

briefDiscrepancy: The audit brief states 4 existing fixtures; the frozen file contains 7. The file is authoritative.
